criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Matching isometric projection, diamond-road axes, and shallow elevated pitch.
The plant, central substation, river, and right-side town occupy the same frame positions.
different: No material yaw, pitch, elevation, or crop difference is visible.

evidence.observation: Isometric world view places the industrial plant left, substation upper-center, and town right.
Projection, viewing angle, landmark placement, and world crop match the reference.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Industrial mass remains concentrated left and lower-left while dense housing fills the right.
Road coverage, rocky open corridors, and occupied-map ratio match.
different: Only fine-grain rooftop and ground-texture rendering varies locally.

evidence.observation: Dense town blocks dominate the right, with industrial clusters and open terrain across the left.
The same clusters, open gaps, roads, and overall mass distribution are present.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: The same dark channel curves from the upper-left through the center toward the lower-left edge.
Bank depth, muted reflections, and bridge attachment points match.
different: Minor ripple and bank-texture details vary without changing the channel geometry.

evidence.observation: A narrow dark-blue river bends behind the upper plant, through the center, and toward the lower-left.
Channel path, width pattern, banks, crossings, and subdued water state visually align.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Plant, transmission tower, substation, hospital, and house silhouettes retain matching relative sizes.
Large facilities and small residential buildings use the same scale hierarchy.
different: No material landmark or facility scale difference is visible.

evidence.observation: The upper-left generating plant establishes the large industrial scale.
The generating plant has the same footprint and height relationship to nearby towers.
The upper-center substation is consistently sized against nearby houses and pylons.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both use blackened metal, dark concrete, rocky soil, restrained blue midtones, and amber point lighting.
Terrain, buildings, conductors, and chrome HUD share the same cohesive weathered finish.
different: CANDIDATE has slightly crisper local ground texture in a few patches.

evidence.observation: Dark soil, soot-stained structures, steel roofs, and warm lamps form a unified industrial material system.
The same dark material palette, surface wear, midtone balance, and amber illumination are retained.
Top chrome uses worn black metal, inset panels, and muted brass accents.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Cyan energized conductors and amber planned conductors follow the same routes.
Tower attachment, substation entry points, and energized/planned distinction are equally readable.
different: Only tiny local glow-intensity variations are visible along some conductor segments.

evidence.observation: Bright cyan lines connect the upper plant, central substation, and right-side town substation.
Cyan routing, tower connections, halos, and energized endpoints match.
Amber dashed construction route crosses the lower map through multiple towers.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Top resource bar, left construction kit, and right inspector use the same industrial chrome and hierarchy.
Overlay ratio, cyan selection accents, and map integration are nearly identical.
different: The CANDIDATE bottom strip is slightly narrower and contains denser icon-plus-label buttons.

evidence.observation: Full-width top chrome contains settings, resources, power, day, and paused status.
Top bar dimensions, dividers, icon scale, typography hierarchy, and status placement match.
Right inspector presents a facility image, capacity meter, and two action buttons.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both strips are independent four-button bars centered against the bottom edge.
Matching dark chrome, inset button hierarchy, cyan active state, and compact HUD integration are visible.
CANDIDATE clearly separates briefing, construction, result, and next stages, with construction highlighted.
different: CANDIDATE is slightly narrower and uses smaller icon-plus-text stage labels instead of the larger playback glyphs.
Stage progress is conveyed through the selected cyan tab rather than any continuous progress fill.

evidence.observation: A centered four-control playback strip uses heavy chrome and a cyan-highlighted active button.
A centered four-stage event bar uses matching chrome; the construction stage is visibly active and result is separately legible.
